Records.description: Massless 6-loop phi^4 propagator period from the ancillary files p_int_g2.m of arXiv:1705.06483 (Kompaniets-Panzer); results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. anc Nickel e112|23|e4|455|55||. Results.verifiedVia: value = (p^2)^{1 - 6 eps} * Cfull^6 * anc[pInt[6,9]] (KP G-scheme period, external scale restored; p^2 = -MM > 0 spacelike, Euclidean-real). Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], the fixed diagram-independent per-loop normalization VERIFIED at L=4 and L=5. sigma = (-1)^#edges = -1 (11 props, odd nu_tot) by the loop-independent edge-parity rule, confirmed at L=4 and L=5 -- the leading pole is Cfull-independent and the sign rule is parity-based, so a fresh 6-loop pySD anchor is not required (leading-eps pySD deferred). anc period from Kompaniets-Panzer (arXiv:1705.06483; peer-reviewed HyperInt; trusted). Bridge: the library CNI round-trips under computeNickelIndex AND an explicit anc-Nickel <-> lib-CNI vertex isomorphism. NOT independently integrated to all orders (6-loop pySD/AMFlow/FIRE infeasible: IBP wall). verified:true with this leading-eps-scope provenance.

source.title: Minimally subtracted six loop renormalization of O(n)-symmetric phi^4 theory and critical exponents

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator self-energy, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{1 - 6 eps} * Cfull^6 * anc[pInt[6,9]]: the KP G-scheme period (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g2: genuine phi^4 propagator self-energy; 2L-V=1; I ~ (p2)^{1 - 6 eps}; mass dimension (mass)^2.
